title: EU provides €61 million in humanitarian aid amidst rapidly deteriorating situation in Ethiopia
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 28 Sep 2026 Amid fears of renewed conflict in Northern Ethiopia, the European Union is providing €61 million in humanitarian funding to help the most vulnerable people in Ethiopia affected by conflict, displacement, disease outbreaks and climate-related hazards, including the impact of El Niño.

title: EU trade agreements continue to benefit European businesses
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 28 Sep 2026 The EU's growing network of trade agreements helps European businesses to access new export markets and creates a more predictable trade and investment environment, according to a report published today.
